description: A 1.21.4 Fabric Mod for the Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki

mods.name: WikiWriter
mods.description: Wiki Editor tools for the official Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki. Type /wikiwriter or /ww to get started.

releases.notes:
Changes since v1.10:
- Updated from 1.20.4 to 1.21.4
- Added support for items with overwritten models
- Added support for forge recipe trees
- Replaced real_lore with lore in item template calls
- Replaced enchantment, rune, and pet lore template calls with their now automated template syntax

mods.name: WikiWriter
mods.description: Wiki Editor tools for the official Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki. Type /wikiwriter or /ww to get started.

releases.notes:
- Rewrote the system for replacing certain types of text in item lore and item names
- Added the ability to automatically fix Collection and SkyBlock Guide menus to be set to 100% and 0% respectively
- Changed inventory lore references to use the real_lore parameter from item templates, and updated README.md to reflect that
- Changed recipe template references to link to automated templates
- Removed ":" being replaced with "." for certain vanilla item IDs
- Removed the ability to removing dungeon stats from item lore (no longer necessary)
- Fixes spaces at the start of lines not showing up (now utilizes thin spaces)
- Fixed some issues with lore templates not being referenced properly
- Fixed issues with the enchanted book textures
